<!-- part: title -->
# Send the weekly report as a CSV file

<!-- part: story -->
Managers asked for a way to send the weekly report to their director or load it into a spreadsheet. [c1]

<!-- part: change -->
The weekly report can now be saved as a CSV file. [c2]
The file has one row per stage and a total row at the end. [c2]

<!-- part: proof -->
The file has the columns stage and deals, then a total row with the pipeline total. [c3]

<!-- part: caveat -->
The download covers the weekly report only. [c4]

<!-- part: status -->
Open your weekly report and save it as a CSV file, released on 18 November 2026. [c2, c5]
